name: pptx
description: Use this skill any time a .pptx file is involved in any way — as input, output, or both. This includes: creating slide decks, pitch decks, or presentations; reading, parsing, or extracting text from any .pptx file; editing, modifying, or updating existing presentations; combining or splitting slide files. Triggers on: ppt, pptx, .pptx, presentation, slide, deck, pitch deck.
